screens.title: Ordinary Reminder details · Sunrise Light
screens.fixture: Unfinished one-off reminder; Event Today 10:00–10:15 AM; Due linked to event start; Alarm Today 10:00 AM scheduled; Home list; notes.
screens.detail:
Screen: ordinary Reminder details, Sunrise LIGHT appearance. Status time "7:30".
Compact toolbar: back arrow, "Reminder", pencil edit, three-dot more. Warm Sunrise landscape vignette below/behind toolbar.
Under header, a small green leaf category badge alongside a 24sp wrapping title "Water plants". Quiet state text "Not done". No checkbox at this title block.
First white information card: section label "When"; date "Today · Wed, 7 Oct"; main time "10:00–10:15 AM". Below a small divider, label/value "Due" / "10:00 AM · At event start". This records Event and linked Due without making the ordinary state look problematic.
Second white card: small alarm-clock icon and "Alarm"; compact explicit status "Scheduled". Main next-alert line "Today at 10:00 AM"; supporting line "At due time". Within this card an outlined, 48dp-height button "Postpone alert". This action is separate from completion.
Then small context card: label "List" and value "Home" with list icon and chevron; do not add a Repeat setting to this one-off reminder.
Then Notes section, white rounded surface, full readable text: "Water the balcony herbs and check the soil before adding more water."
At the lower content area a quiet disclosure row "Schedule details" with chevron. Use natural spaces, no giant empty area. Bottom fixed footer: full-width Sunrise orange button, sufficiently dark navy/brown text, exactly "Done". Small Android gesture bar beneath. No date picker or keyboard.
Maintain obvious hierarchy: title then Event/Due, then Alarm delivery, then list/notes. Distinguish Postpone alert from Done.
screens.initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one production-plausible Android Remilo app screenshot for design evaluation.
Create exactly ONE flat portrait screen, edge-to-edge 4:9 aspect ratio, approximately 840 x 1870 pixels representing a 360 x 800 dp phone viewport. No device frame, no punch hole, no surrounding poster, no annotation captions or comparison collage.
Input images are approved Remilo R3 visual STYLE REFERENCES: Image 1 is Sunrise Light Agenda; Image 2 is Night Dark Agenda. Extend the same product to a secondary screen according to the specified structure; do not copy the Agenda content, chips, bottom tabs, or add button. Keep its typeface, icon stroke, card corners, category badge style, colors and landscape illustration language.
Compact secondary opening: status bar 24dp, then about 96dp TOTAL including a 56dp toolbar and a short panoramic landscape crop. The art is a recognisable tonal lake / mountains / conifers vignette, with soft gradients and a quiet sky behind toolbar text. It must not consume the large Agenda header height. Sunrise Light uses warm cream/apricot sky, opaque white cards and dark navy text. Night Dark uses moonlit navy sky and charcoal/navy reading surface with opaque slightly raised navy cards, white primary and light slate secondary text. Category colors independent of atmosphere. Stable amber/red warning colors independent of theme.
Realistic mobile UI typography: toolbar20sp, ordinary text16sp, secondary text14sp, important details title24sp, modest section labels14sp. Target visible controls 48dp tap areas, 16dp horizontal margins, 12–16dp rounded cards, close intentional vertical spacing. Do not shrink typography to squeeze content. Long titles and notes wrap naturally. Solid readable text backgrounds, no gradients behind reading content. Crisp real Android vector-like icons, not emoji.
Screens are all one coherent real product. Details have Back / Reminder / Edit pencil / More in toolbar; editor has Back / its specified title, without duplicate Save action in toolbar. Secondary screens have no root bottom navigation and no floating add button. Use a fixed bottom action area with a single full-width 56dp filled primary button, side margins16dp and gesture-safe padding. Form and content scroll above the footer. Preserve title / timing / delivery semantics exactly; no extraneous promises, slogans, progress praise, or invented controls.

screens.title: Overdue Reminder details · Night Dark
screens.fixture: Unfinished one-off reminder; Event Today 4:00–4:30 PM; Due Today 5:00 PM independent, overdue; Alarm postponed Tomorrow 9:00 AM; Work list.
screens.detail:
Screen: overdue Reminder details with a postponed alert, NIGHT DARK appearance. Status time "9:30".
Compact toolbar: back arrow, "Reminder", pencil edit, more. Small moonlit landscape crop in top opening with a crescent and sparse stars, exactly the approved Night identity. Main screen below is dark navy.
Title block: small document category badge, title "Send the revised proposal and confirm delivery dates", 24sp and two or three lines. A small amber clock/warning icon beside the explicit status "Overdue · Not done". Color alone must not carry this state.
First raised dark information card: "When"; "Today · Wed, 7 Oct"; "4:00–4:30 PM". Divider. Due label "Due"; prominent warm amber value "Today at 5:00 PM"; supporting text "Independent of event". Due remains overdue.
Second raised dark card: alarm-clock icon and "Alarm"; visible state "Postponed". Clearly labeled next delivery "Next alert"; main value "Tomorrow at 9:00 AM". Supporting text "Event and due time are unchanged." Inside card an outlined 48dp-height button "Postpone alert". This is the scheduled postponed alert, NOT a Stop/Snooze ringing screen, not completed, and not a rescheduled Event. Do not claim delivered, missed, or failed.
Context row "List" value "Work". Notes surface with realistic text "Attach the revised pricing sheet and confirm the delivery window with Maya."
At content end a "Schedule details" disclosure. Content can naturally scroll, but keep the overdue Due and postponed next alarm both visible at once.
Fixed bottom footer with a full-width Night periwinkle filled button labeled "Done", dark navy high contrast text, gesture bar. No root tabs, checkbox control beside title, FAB, or giant low-contrast finished text. Done is distinct from Postpone alert.

screens.title: New Reminder with keyboard · Sunrise Light
screens.fixture: Title focused; Today 7:40–8:10 AM from now+10 minutes/default30-minute duration; Due linked event start, Alarm follows Due; No repeat; No list.
screens.detail:
Screen: New reminder creation with Android keyboard OPEN, Sunrise LIGHT appearance. Status time "7:30". Compact toolbar "New reminder" and back arrow, no toolbar Save. Same compact Sunrise landscape identity but compressed enough for keyboard workflow; no tall hero.
Scrollable form:
First rounded white outlined Title input with label "Title", focused warm orange outline, cursor at end, actual entered text "Pick up prescription and ask about the refill schedule" wrapping to TWO lines at normal16sp. Title field grows to fit; no ellipsis.
Below, label "When"; separate tappable date row with calendar icon "Today · Wed, 7 Oct" and chevron; separate time row with clock icon "7:40–8:10 AM" and chevron. This is the default30-minute Event starting10minutes from the7:30 clock. Small supporting summary "Due at event start".
Then tappable Repeat row with repeat icon and text "Does not repeat"; chevron. Then Alert row with alarm-clock icon, text "Alarm", supporting "At due time"; chevron.
Only the first rows fit above keyboard at normal scale; remaining "List" (No list) and "Add notes" belong farther down the scrollable form. Do NOT try to fit all fields and advanced options by shrinking them. It is fine if the List row only begins above the fixed footer or is below the viewport. No repeated extra timing values.
A fixed pale footer directly ABOVE the keyboard with a SINGLE full-width orange 56dp button labeled "Save"; sufficient contrast dark text. It must not obscure visible input text. The focused Title already contains valid text, so Save is enabled. No Done button.
The lower ~270dp of viewport is a realistic Android Gboard-style light keyboard, with a suggestion strip reading "schedule" "schedules" "scheduled", three full QWERTY rows with letter keys, shift, backspace, "?123", comma, spacebar labeled English, period, blue/gray return key. Realistic thumb-size key spacing, bottom navigation/gesture inset. Keyboard is part of the screenshot, not floating outside phone. No root tabs or FAB, no bottom Save beneath the keyboard.
Keep finite realistic viewport: normal-size text, some content below fold, Save reachable while typing. Keyboard-open state should be obvious.
